anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: No fact moved: both outputs place the two-choice gate labeled "approve the write" / "decline" after the three ordered findings, with a prose paragraph ("The comment is posted before..." / "I will re-fetch the ticket right before writing...") separating the options from the preceding ordered list so they render as 1 and 2, and both wait without writing. Note that Before already satisfied layout and mapped-pick on its text, so the "fails -> holds" expectation there is not borne out by the outputs. In checkpoint 2 both outputs name "approve the write" in one sentence ("Taking 4 as option 1 - approve the write.") before the re-fetch and simulated comment-then-status writes, and both accept typed `yes` as plain approval without a numeric echo. After successfully adds the `gauntlet: gate=check-delivery/confirmation-gate` first line and the done/stuck markers while keeping `Delivered: abc1234` first in the comment. One caution against the Change's own stated intent: After embeds `gauntlet: done delivered` and `gauntlet: stuck write declined` inside the fenced blocks that represent the human-facing assistant reply, which is a gauntlet line in a human-channel payload; the wording should direct the model to emit the marker as a separate report line outside the quoted human message (or only in the tracker/report channel) so the human-visible text stays marker-free while the mapped-pick sentence remains the first human-facing line before any simulated mutation.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After keeps every fact Before kept: checkpoint 1 still ends with three ordered findings, prose, the exact proposed write, a 'Pick one:' line, and a separated two-choice gate rendering as 1 (approve the write) and 2 (decline) with no write; the `4` reply is resolved by label ('Taking 4 as option 1 - approve the write.') before the re-fetch, comment, then Ready advance; `yes` is accepted as explicit approval without numeric mapping; decline and other replies perform no write. What moved is outside the listed facts but contradicts the Change paragraph itself: After emits `gauntlet: gate=check-delivery/confirmation-gate` at the top of the human-facing confirmation and `gauntlet: done delivered` / `gauntlet: stuck write declined` lines inside the checkpoint-2 human replies, and in the `4` case that marker precedes the label-naming sentence, so the first thing the human reads after their reply is a machine line rather than the resolved option. To deliver the Change while keeping the outputs clean, specify that the confirmation-gate id and ending/STOP ids are emitted as out-of-band status (or at most once, after the human-facing text), that the label-naming sentence must be the first line of the response to a numeric reply, and that human-channel payloads (findings, gate, evidence comment, decision echoes) never carry a gauntlet line; keep the existing 'Pick one:' separator, the `Delivered:`-first comment, and the 'Reply 1 or yes to approve' hint, which already satisfy layout, mapped-pick, and plain-yes.
